query: Which country won the Eurovision Song Contest 2026?
answer: Bulgaria won the Eurovision Song Contest 2026, its first ever victory. The winning entry was "Bangaranga" by DARA, and the grand final was held in Vienna, Austria, in mid-May 2026 [1][2][3]. Israel came second [4], and Ukraine came ninth [5]. I only checked headlines and a search summary, not the full articles. The summary said DARA scored 516 points and Romania came third, but I haven't confirmed those details.
